Touch (`touch`): per-touch: id, x, y, screenX, screenY, startX, startY, dx, dy, distance, justStarted, justEnded
swipe: active, direction, dx, dy, distance
Global state (`global`): Read, write and test arbitrary named in-memory values shared by scripts; resets when the game page is reloaded.

editorSettings.note: These are stored implementation defaults and project registries; the supplied editor has no general Settings dialog to edit performance preferences.

sharedRelayTools.name: get_editor_state
sharedRelayTools.description: Overview of the open Realot editor: project name, whether the game is playing, selected entity ids, entity count, available component types.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_entities
sharedRelayTools.description: List every entity in the current scene (id, name, tag, active, component types, x/y position).

sharedRelayTools.name: get_entity
sharedRelayTools.description: Full data of one entity: all components with every property.

sharedRelayTools.name: create_entity
sharedRelayTools.description: Create an entity. 'components' maps a component type (e.g. SpriteRenderer, Collider2D, Rigidbody2D, Script) to its properties. A Transform is always added. Undoable with undo. Values are validated: wrong types, unknown properties, invalid enum values (e.g. Light.type), out-of-range numbers, bad hex colors and values the engine would silently clamp are rejected with a message listing every problem and the allowed values; nothing is changed on error.

sharedRelayTools.name: update_component
sharedRelayTools.description: Change properties of an existing component on an entity (only properties the component already has). Use get_entity first to see them. Values are validated: wrong types, unknown properties, invalid enum values (e.g. Light.type), out-of-range numbers, bad hex colors and values the engine would silently clamp are rejected with a message listing every problem and the allowed values; nothing is changed on error.

sharedRelayTools.name: add_component
sharedRelayTools.description: Add a component to an entity. Values are validated: wrong types, unknown properties, invalid enum values (e.g. Light.type), out-of-range numbers, bad hex colors and values the engine would silently clamp are rejected with a message listing every problem and the allowed values; nothing is changed on error.

sharedRelayTools.name: remove_component
sharedRelayTools.description: Remove a component (not Transform) from an entity.

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_entities
sharedRelayTools.description: Delete entities by id (same as pressing Delete in the editor). Undoable.

sharedRelayTools.name: select_entities
sharedRelayTools.description: Select entities in the editor so the user sees them in the Inspector.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_scripts
sharedRelayTools.description: Names of all scripts in the project.

sharedRelayTools.name: get_script
sharedRelayTools.description: Source code of a script.

sharedRelayTools.name: write_script
sharedRelayTools.description: Create or overwrite a script's source code. Entities already using this script get the new code too. Reports syntax errors.

sharedRelayTools.name: attach_script
sharedRelayTools.description: Attach an existing script to an entity (adds a Script component).

sharedRelayTools.name: set_playing
sharedRelayTools.description: Start or stop play mode (opens the game in the play window).

sharedRelayTools.name: get_console
sharedRelayTools.description: Recent editor/play console lines (logs, warnings, script errors).

sharedRelayTools.name: screenshot
sharedRelayTools.description: Image of the scene viewport as the user sees it.

sharedRelayTools.name: undo
sharedRelayTools.description: Undo the last editor change.

sharedRelayTools.name: redo
sharedRelayTools.description: Redo the last undone change.

sharedRelayTools.name: save_project
sharedRelayTools.description: Save now (browser autosave slot, and the .realot file if one is being kept up to date).

sharedRelayTools.name: list_assets
sharedRelayTools.description: List imported images and audio without returning binary data, grouped like the editor's Project folders: Sprites, Animation Clips (uploaded animation frames) and Tiles (tileset images), plus Audio. Use the keys in SpriteRenderer, AudioSource, animation clips, and tilesets.

kind.description: animation (alias frame) = Animation Clips folder; tile = Tiles folder.

sharedRelayTools.name: begin_asset_upload
sharedRelayTools.description: Start uploading a custom asset: a sprite, audio file, animation source, tileset image, or a loose image for the Animation Clips folder (purpose 'frame-asset') or Tiles folder (purpose 'tile-asset'). Then send sequential base64 chunks with append_asset_upload_chunk and finish with complete_asset_upload. The editor must be open and connected. Maximum 20 MiB per file. Purpose 'project-zip' (a .realot/.zip project, max 20 MiB) REPLACES the entire open project and asks the person at the editor to confirm. Animation uploads land in the Animation Clips folder; tileset uploads land in the Tiles folder.

entity_id.description: Required for animation-image, animation-zip, animation-gif, and animation-sheet.

role.description: Required for tileset-tile; use a role from list_tilesets.

group.description: Optional heading to list a frame-asset or tile-asset under in its folder.

sharedRelayTools.name: append_asset_upload_chunk
sharedRelayTools.description: Send one base64-encoded binary chunk for an active asset upload. Chunks must be independent base64 strings, sequential from index 0. Use the chunk size returned by begin_asset_upload; retrying the same index and data is safe.

sharedRelayTools.name: complete_asset_upload
sharedRelayTools.description: Validate and import all received bytes using the editor's native import pipeline. Call only after every chunk has been accepted.

sharedRelayTools.name: cancel_asset_upload
sharedRelayTools.description: Discard a staged upload before it is imported.

sharedRelayTools.name: rename_asset
sharedRelayTools.description: Rename an imported sprite, animation frame, tile or audio asset while preserving its key and references.

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_asset
sharedRelayTools.description: Delete an imported asset. If the asset is referenced by scenes or prefabs, the first call reports those references; set confirm=true only when it is acceptable to leave them unresolved.

confirm.description: Explicitly confirm deletion even when references exist.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_animations
sharedRelayTools.description: List animation clips and ordered frame keys for every entity in the active scene.

sharedRelayTools.name: open_editor_panel
sharedRelayTools.description: Open the animation editor, tileset editor, physics-layer panel, or navigation-area panel. Animation and tileset panels need the matching entity_id.

sharedRelayTools.name: create_animation_clip
sharedRelayTools.description: Create an empty animation clip on an entity, adding SpriteAnimation if needed, and open it in the animation editor.

sharedRelayTools.name: update_animation_clip
sharedRelayTools.description: Change an animation clip name, frame rate, loop setting, or collider override. Set collider_override to null to remove the override.

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_animation_clip
sharedRelayTools.description: Delete one animation clip from its entity. The remaining clips and frames are preserved.

sharedRelayTools.name: move_animation_frame
sharedRelayTools.description: Reorder an animation frame by moving it from one zero-based position to another.

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_animation_frame
sharedRelayTools.description: Remove one zero-based frame position from an animation clip without deleting the underlying imported asset.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_tilesets
sharedRelayTools.description: List tilesets, tile dimensions, and sprite keys assigned to each role.

sharedRelayTools.name: update_tileset
sharedRelayTools.description: Edit a tileset name, tile dimensions, or selected role-to-sprite assignments. Set a slot to null to clear it.

slots.description: Partial role-to-sprite-key map; use null to clear a role.

sharedRelayTools.name: add_animation_frames
sharedRelayTools.description: Add images that are already in the project (sprites, Animation Clips frames, or Tiles) to an animation clip as frames. Use list_assets for keys and list_animations for entity/clip ids. Optional index inserts at that position instead of appending. Undoable.

sharedRelayTools.name: set_tileset_slot
sharedRelayTools.description: Put an existing project image (sprite, animation frame or tile) in one slot of a Tileset, or clear the slot with asset_key null. Roles come from list_tilesets.

sharedRelayTools.name: slice_asset_into_tileset
sharedRelayTools.description: Cut one existing project image (for example an uploaded sprite) into a 4x4 grid and fill all 16 Tileset slots with the pieces. The pieces are saved in the Tiles folder under the tileset's name. Undoable.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_tilemaps
sharedRelayTools.description: List Tilemap entities, their assigned tileset entity, painted cell count, and up to 500 grid coordinates.

sharedRelayTools.name: paint_tilemap
sharedRelayTools.description: Paint or erase grid cells on a Tilemap. Coordinates are integer cell columns and rows, not world coordinates. Undoable.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_navigation_worlds
sharedRelayTools.description: List NavWorld2D entities with bounds, cell size, painted cell counts, and navigation settings.

sharedRelayTools.name: paint_navigation_cells
sharedRelayTools.description: Paint walkable or blocked navigation cells, restore baked walkability, or set/clear navigation area indices. Coordinates are integer grid columns and rows. Undoable.

sharedRelayTools.name: update_navigation_world
sharedRelayTools.description: Edit NavWorld2D bounds, cell size, obstacle threshold, diagonal movement, dynamic mode, or all 16 area costs. Cell changes invalidate the baked runtime cache.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_navigation_areas
sharedRelayTools.description: List the 16 named navigation area slots and their indices.

sharedRelayTools.name: set_navigation_area_name
sharedRelayTools.description: Rename one navigation area slot. Slot 0 is the default Ground area and cannot be cleared.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_physics_layers
sharedRelayTools.description: List all 16 named physics layers and their indices.

sharedRelayTools.name: set_physics_layer_name
sharedRelayTools.description: Rename one of the 16 physics layer slots. Slot 0 is the default layer and cannot be cleared.

sharedRelayTools.name: set_collider_layer_filter
sharedRelayTools.description: Set a Collider2D's physics layer and the layer indices it collides with. Use list_physics_layers to map names to indices.

sharedRelayTools.name: set_editor_tool
sharedRelayTools.description: Choose a viewport tool and optionally select its Tilemap, NavWorld2D, or StrokePath entity so the user can continue painting in the editor.

sharedRelayTools.name: update_entity
sharedRelayTools.description: Rename an entity or change its tag, active flag, or hierarchy folder. Use update_component for Transform and other components.

patch.description: Any of: name (string), tag (string; new tags are added to the registry), active (boolean), folderId (string|null)

sharedRelayTools.name: list_scenes
sharedRelayTools.description: List every scene in the project and which one is active.

sharedRelayTools.name: create_scene
sharedRelayTools.description: Create a new scene (with a Main Camera). Switches to it unless switch=false.

switch.description: Switch to the new scene (default true)

sharedRelayTools.name: switch_scene
sharedRelayTools.description: Make another scene the active one in the editor.

sharedRelayTools.name: rename_scene
sharedRelayTools.description: Rename a scene.

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_scene
sharedRelayTools.description: Delete a scene. Cannot be undone, so the first call only reports what would be deleted; repeat with confirm=true. A project must keep one scene.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_tags
sharedRelayTools.description: List the project tag registry.

sharedRelayTools.name: add_tag
sharedRelayTools.description: Add a tag to the registry.

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_tag
sharedRelayTools.description: Remove a tag from the registry (Untagged cannot be removed).

sharedRelayTools.name: list_prefabs
sharedRelayTools.description: List prefabs in the project.

sharedRelayTools.name: create_prefab
sharedRelayTools.description: Create a prefab from an entity and link that entity to it.

sharedRelayTools.name: instantiate_prefab
sharedRelayTools.description: Place a new instance of a prefab in the active scene.

sharedRelayTools.name: rename_prefab
sharedRelayTools.description: Rename a prefab.

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_prefab
sharedRelayTools.description: Delete a prefab from the catalogue; existing instances become unlinked. First call reports impact; repeat with confirm=true.

sharedRelayTools.name: list_folders
sharedRelayTools.description: List Hierarchy folders in the active scene (id, name, parentId).

sharedRelayTools.name: create_folder
sharedRelayTools.description: Create a Hierarchy folder, optionally nested in another. Put entities in it with update_entity folderId.

parent_id.description: Parent folder id (omit for top level)

sharedRelayTools.name: rename_folder
sharedRelayTools.description: Rename a Hierarchy folder.

sharedRelayTools.name: move_folder
sharedRelayTools.description: Nest a folder inside another folder, or move it to the top level (omit parent_id). Cycles are refused.

parent_id.description: New parent folder id; omit for top level

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_folder
sharedRelayTools.description: Delete a folder. Its entities and sub-folders move up one level; nothing inside is deleted.

sharedRelayTools.name: update_prefab
sharedRelayTools.description: Push an instance's current data to its prefab and to every non-overridden instance across all scenes (the editor's Update Prefab).

id.description: Entity id of a prefab instance

sharedRelayTools.name: revert_prefab
sharedRelayTools.description: Reset a prefab instance to its prefab's data, discarding overrides.

id.description: Entity id of a prefab instance

sharedRelayTools.name: unpack_prefab
sharedRelayTools.description: Unlink an instance from its prefab, keeping its current data.

id.description: Entity id of a prefab instance

sharedRelayTools.name: duplicate_scene
sharedRelayTools.description: Duplicate a scene (deep copy) and add it to the project. Does not switch to it.

sharedRelayTools.name: delete_script
sharedRelayTools.description: Delete a script from the project and clear it from objects using it. Cannot be undone, so the first call reports usage; repeat with confirm=true.

sharedRelayTools.name: set_script_enabled
sharedRelayTools.description: Enable or disable the Script component on an entity without removing it.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

sharedRelayTools.name: bake_navworld
sharedRelayTools.description: Bake a NavWorld2D from the scene's colliders (the editor's Bake button). Reports walkable and blocked cell counts.

id.description: Entity id with a NavWorld2D component

sharedRelayTools.name: set_paused
sharedRelayTools.description: Pause or resume the running game. The game must be playing (see set_playing).

paused.description: true to pause, false to resume

sharedRelayTools.name: export_game
sharedRelayTools.description: Build the game as a standalone HTML5 or PWA ZIP. By default it also downloads the ZIP in the editor's browser; read the bytes with read_export_chunk. APK builds are not supported through MCP.

download.description: Also download in the editor browser (default true)

sharedRelayTools.name: read_export_chunk
sharedRelayTools.description: Read one base64 chunk of the last export_game ZIP.

sharedRelayTools.name: release_export
sharedRelayTools.description: Free the memory held by the last export_game result.

sharedRelayTools.name: download_project_zip
sharedRelayTools.description: Save the whole project as a .realot ZIP, downloaded in the editor's browser (File > Save Project without a file handle).
